notes.title: Saint Hazel's Horsepital is going Free to play!
notes.notes:
Saint Hazel's Horsepital is an experience to say the least, and sharing that experience with as many people as possible has always been our goal. 

So I am happy to say that you can soon [u]play Saint Hazel's Horsepital for free![/u] So call your grandma, ready your pitchforks and come save Buddy the horse!

notes.title: Camera skipping bug fixed!
notes.notes:
The camera skipping bug should now be fixed! Apologies for the late patch.
The spinning camera bug and controllers not always working can be improved using Big Picture mode on Steam for now, but we're looking into a permanent fix.

Thank you for your patience! If you have any other issues feel free to contact us on our twitter, @Hyphn, or on our email, Hyphnsb@gmail.com.

notes.title: Camera Bug Known!
notes.notes: Hello! Some players are reporting a weird bug with the camera. We are aware of the problem and will be uploading a fix as soon as possible! Thank you for your understanding and patience!
